outlooks.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CORRIDOR FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC TO THE CAROLINAS. OTHER SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY MOVE EASTWARD OFF THE GULF AND AFFECT PARTS OF NORTHERN AND CENTRAL FLORIDA AND SOUTHERN GEORGIA.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER-AIR PATTERN THIS PERIOD WILL BE CHARACTERIZED BY TWO PRIMARY/SYNOPTIC-SCALE FEATURES... 1. SPLIT FLOW AROUND REX BLOCK LOCATED OVER WRN NORTH AMERICA...WITH HIGH-AMPLITUDE RIDGING OVER NWRN STATES AND BROAD/WEAK CYCLONE OFFSHORE CA. 2. LARGE CYCLONE NOW CENTERED OVER MB/ONT BORDER WITH TROUGH SSEWD OVER MS VALLEY. THIS CYCLONE SHOULD SHIFT SLOWLY SEWD OVER LS THROUGH PERIOD...WHILE SEVERAL SHORTWAVES PIVOT THROUGH SRN SEMICIRCLE OF ITS ACCOMPANYING CYCLONIC-FLOW FIELD. STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER LOWER OH VALLEY -- WILL LIFT NNEWD ACROSS LOWER MI TO ERN LS AREA BY 00Z THEN NWD ACROSS NWRN ONT. IN ITS WAKE...WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- EVIDENT IN MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER AR/LA -- WILL EJECT ENEWD ACROSS CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. AT SFC...11Z ANALYSIS SHOWED DEEP/985-MB LOW OVER NWRN LOWER MI...COLD FRONT FROM THERE ACROSS INDIANA...SERN LA...AND DEEP S TX...AND WARM FRONT SEWD ACROSS NERN OH...SWRN PA...WEAK THROUGH WEAK LOW IN NRN MD...AND ACROSS SRN CHESAPEAKE BAY. WARM FRONT IS FCST TO MOVE NEWD SLOWLY TO NERN PA AND NJ BY 00Z....WHEN SFC LOW SHOULD BE LOCATED OVER ONT NE OF LS. BY 00Z COLD FRONT WILL ARC SEWD FROM OCCLUSION TRIPLE POINT OVER PA SWWD ACROSS

sections.title: NRN FL/SRN GA/SERN AL REGION
sections.text: LENGTHY AND SOMEWHAT ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE IS PROCEEDING EWD ACROSS CENTRAL/NRN GULF...NRN PORTION OF WHICH SHOULD BRUSH AAF AREA BEFORE MCS HEADS E TOWARD NWRN FL. REF SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 394 FOR NEAR-TERM FCST DETAILS. THOUGH LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL WEAKEN AS A RESULT...SOME WLY COMPONENT TO NEAR-SFC FLOW WILL ADVECT HIGHER-THETAE AIR MASS OFF ERN GULF TO REPLACE RELATIVELY DRY DEW-POINT POCKET ANALYZED AT 11Z OVER NRN FL. THIS...ALONG WITH DIURNAL HEATING...WILL BOOST BUOYANCY INLAND AND CONTRIBUTE TO WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYER...BENEATH 1000-2000 J/KG MLCAPE. MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD HELP TO MAINTAIN/ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT GUSTS AS WELL AS TO MAINTAIN OCNL SVR HAIL. NRN PART OF THIS AREA ALSO WILL RESIDE BENEATH MIDDLE TO LEFT-EXIT REGION OF SUBTROPICAL-BRANCH SPEED MAX ALOFT...WHICH WILL COINCIDE WITH STG DIFLUENCE ALOFT. ADDITIONAL TSTMS ARE LIKELY ALONG FL E-COAST SEA BREEZE...WITH RISK OF ISOLATED HAIL AND DAMAGING GUSTS. ..EDWARDS/PICCA.. 04/20/2015

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CORRIDOR FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC TO THE CAROLINAS. OTHER SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY AFFECT PARTS OF NORTHERN AND EASTERN FLORIDA AND SOUTHERN GEORGIA.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS MUCH OF THE ERN USA
NY/PA
sections.text: A LARGE UPPER TROUGH DOMINATES THE WEATHER OVER THE EASTERN UNITED STATES TODAY...WITH THE PRIMARY SURFACE FRONT CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM OH INTO AL. ONE SHORTWAVE TROUGH EMBEDDED IN THE CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT IS OVER KY/OH...AND WILL ROTATE NORTHEASTWARD INTO WV/WESTERN PA LATER TODAY. SLOW DAYTIME HEATING AHEAD OF THIS SYSTEM...COUPLED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S...WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 1000 J/KG. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT AHEAD OF THE TROUGH OVER WESTERN PA AND TRACK QUICKLY EASTWARD. STRONG DEEP-LAYER EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL PROMOTE BOWING STORM STRUCTURES AND PERHAPS SUPERCELLS. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREAT...BUT HAIL WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGER CORES.

sections.title: WV/VA
sections.text: THUNDERSTORMS ARE LIKELY TO FORM OVER EASTERN WV AND WESTERN VA BY MID AFTERNOON AS STRONGER FORCING EMERGES ON THE EAST SIDE OF THE APPALACHIANS. FORECAST SOUNDINGS WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ROTATING STORMS...BUT MOST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS MIXED STORM MODE WITH SEVERAL BOWING SEGMENTS. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE THE MAIN THREAT. IF STORMS CAN MAINTAIN DISCRETE MODE...ISOLATED TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

sections.title: NC/SC INTO NRN GA
sections.text: 12Z CAM SOLUTIONS CONTINUE TO SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON FROM WESTERN NC INTO UPSTATE SC. THESE STORMS WILL TRACK EASTWARD ACROSS MUCH OF NC DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING...POSING A RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO INTO SWRN NC.

sections.title: FL/GA
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE CURRENTLY AFFECTING PARTS OF NORTH FL. OTHER MORE INTENSE CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MID AFTERNOON OTHER THE NORTHERN AND EASTERN FL PENINSULA AS DAYTIME HEATING LIFT AHEAD OF AN APPROACHING UPPER SYSTEM HELP TO DESTABILIZE THE AIR MASS. STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR OVER THIS REGION WITH HAIL AND WIND POSSIBLE. REFER TO MCD NUMBER 395 FOR FURTHER DETAILS.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST AL/SOUTHWEST GA
sections.text: WILL MAINTAIN LOW SEVERE PROBABILITIES FOR PARTS OF EASTERN AL/WESTERN GA WHERE ISOLATED STRONG THUNDERSTORMS MAY FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT LATER TODAY. WIDESPREAD CLOUDS CURRENTLY IN THIS AREA LIMIT CONFIDENCE IN A GREATER SEVERE THREAT. ..HART/JEWELL.. 04/20/2015

outlooks.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING FROM THE MID-ATLANTIC TO THE CAROLINAS. OTHER STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL PERSIST THROUGH EARLY EVENING OVER A PORTION OF CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN FLORIDA.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER SRN THROUGH CNTRL FL
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM GA INTO THE MID ATLANTIC AND A PORTION OF THE NERN STATES...

sections.title: NERN U.S. THROUGH MID ATLANTIC
sections.text: THE PREVIOUS FORECAST APPEARS MOSTLY ON TRACK WITH ONLY MODEST ADJUSTMENTS FOR THIS AREA THIS UPDATE. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE IN PROCESS OF DEVELOPING IN WEAKLY CAPPED PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR FROM THE CAROLINAS NWD INTO WRN PARTS OF THE NERN STATES. DIABATIC WARMING IS SUPPORTING MLCAPE FROM 500 J/KG OVER CNTRL/WRN PA TO 1000-1500 J/KG OVER THE CAROLINAS WHERE THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS MORE MOIST. BELT OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT ACCOMPANYING THE SYNOPTIC TROUGH IS CONTRIBUTING TO 40-50 KT UNIDIRECTIONAL SHEAR AND SOME INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SHEAR MAY OCCUR TOWARD EVENING AS THE LLJ STRENGTHENS. BOTH SUPERCELL AND ORGANIZED MULTICELLS ARE LIKELY WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THE PRIMARY THREATS...THROUGH A FEW TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE.

sections.title: FL
sections.text: PRIMARY CHANGE TO FL HAS BEEN TO REMOVE NRN FL FROM THREAT AREA DUE TO STABILIZATION IN WAKE OF MCS. OTHERWISE NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS...SOME STRONG TO SEVERE WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL INTO EARLY EVENING. ..DIAL.. 04/20/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1229 PM CDT MON APR 20 2015/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS MAY GRADUALLY DEVELOP INLAND/INCREASE THIS MORNING ACROSS PARTS OF THE FL PANHANDLE/NORTH FL AND EVENTUALLY FAR SOUTHERN GA. A WATCH ISSUANCE DOES NOT SEEM IMMINENT /AS OF 1230Z/...BUT A WATCH COULD BECOME NECESSARY FOR PORTIONS OF THE REGION LATER THIS MORNING/AFTERNOON. A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK UPGRADE WILL OCCUR WITH THE 13Z DAY 1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK UPDATE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE NORTHEASTERN PORTION OF 300+ MILE NEARLY CONTINUOUS SQUALL LINE /THAT EXTENDS INTO THE CENTRAL GULF OF MEXICO/ CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY APPROACH NEAR-COASTAL PARTS OF THE FL PANHANDLE EARLY THIS MORNING INCLUDING THE APALACHICOLA VICINITY. BASED ON THE RECENT 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM TALLAHASSEE...SOME NEAR-SURFACE INHIBITION EXISTS INLAND PARTICULARLY GIVEN MODEST MOISTURE QUALITY/BOUNDARY-LAYER DEPTH. PRE-SQUALL LINE INFLOW/CONVERGENCE IS ALSO LIMITED BY SOUTHWESTERLY NEAR-SURFACE WINDS AND RELATIVELY WEAK WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS BETWEEN 1-3 KM AGL AS PER TALLAHASSEE WSR-88D VWP DATA AND THE 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDING. NONETHELESS...A NEAR-COASTAL STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE RISK...MAINLY IN THE FORM OF DAMAGING WINDS...WILL EXIST THROUGH THE EARLY/MID-MORNING HOURS AS SEMI-ORGANIZED CONVECTION MOVES INLAND. THE OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE INTO LATE MORNING AS SOME ADDITIONAL HEATING/MOISTENING OCCURS...AND AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND MID/HIGH-LEVEL SPEED MAX CURRENTLY OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY/CENTRAL GULF COAST INCREASINGLY INFLUENCES THE REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE CLUSTERS OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY EARLY AFTERNOON WITH LOCALLY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS IS IN PLACE ACROSS MUCH OF THE FLORIDA PENINSULA WITH PRECIPITABLE WATER OVER 1.80 INCHES. IN ADDITION...COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT EXIST WITH 500 MB TEMPERATURES OF -12 C MEASURED AT TBW THIS MORNING. DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS ALSO FORMIDABLE...AND TCU ARE ALREADY DEVELOPING DUE TO AREAS OF HEATING DESPITE CIRRUS. SOME DRYING IS OCCURRING FROM W TO E ACROSS THE MID PORTION OF THE PENINSULA DUE TO THE WLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW. THIS WILL LIKELY CONCENTRATE CONVERGENCE AND MOISTURE NEAR AN E-COAST LOW PRESSURE TROUGH. MULTICELLS ARE EXPECTED TO BE THE DOMINANT STORM MODE...WITH ROBUST UPDRAFTS AIDING IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF HAIL AND WIND. AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL IS POSSIBLE...WITH A CONDITIONAL AND BRIEF TORNADO THREAT SHOULD A SEVERE STORM FORM ON THE SERN FL SEA BREEZE WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE ENHANCED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS PORTIONS OF UPSTATE SC INTO WESTERN AND CENTRAL NC. HAIL AND STRONG WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT BUT A TORNADO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT. A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING OVER NORTHEAST GA AHEAD OF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT. WHILE INITIAL STORMS MAY PRODUCE SOME GUSTY WINDS OR SMALL HAIL...THE GREATER THREAT FOR SEVERE WEATHER WILL BE FURTHER DOWNSTREAM ACROSS PARTS OF UPSTATE SC INTO WESTERN AND CENTRAL NC. HERE...TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE 70S WITH SOME AREAS NEAR 80 DEGREES EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE SOME HIGH CLOUDS ARE MOVING OVER THE REGION...SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY EXISTS WITH MESOANALYSIS INDICATING A NEARLY UNCAPPED ENVIRONMENT. AS EVIDENCE OF THIS...CU DEVELOPMENT WAS NOTED IN LATEST VIS SATELLITE IMAGERY FROM NEAR THE SC/NC BORDER INTO CENTRAL NC. STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES THAT COULD REMAIN SEMI-DISCRETE. MODEST MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT /-14 DEG C AT 500 MB PER GSO 12Z RAOB/ WILL SUPPORT SEVERE HAIL. FAST STORM MOTION AND DCAPE NEAR 1000 J/KG ALSO WILL SUPPORT STRONG/LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. WHILE THE TORNADO THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN LOW...HI-RES GUIDANCE SUGGESTS SOME BACKING OF LOW-LEVEL WINDS IS POSSIBLE AS A WEAK SURFACE TROUGH DEVELOPS AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT ACROSS CENTRAL NC INTO N-CENTRAL SC. A BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT IF THIS OCCURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE LIKELY LATER THIS AFTERNOON WITH HAIL, DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS CU INCREASING ALONG THE LEE OF THE APPALACHIANS AS WELL AS INTO CENTRAL VA WHERE STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING. DEEPER CU FIELDS ARE ALSO NOTED ALONG A STATIONARY BOUNDARY FROM SERN PA INTO SRN NJ. A N-S ORIENTED BAND OF CIRRUS IS ROUGHLY JUXTAPOSED WITH COOLING ALOFT...WITH DEEPER CU INTO THE WELL MIXED BUT DRIER AIR FROM WRN PA SWWD. OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...STORMS WILL FORM WITHIN THE BROAD LOW PRESSURE TROUGH...AND ALSO PERHAPS NEAR THE STATIONARY/WARM FRONT. STRENGTHENING WIND FIELDS WITH THE UPPER TROUGH WILL AID IN NWD TRANSPORT OF MOISTURE INTO AREAS THAT ARE CURRENTLY STABLE SUCH AS PA....LEADING TO STORM DEVELOPMENT. WHILE THE MAIN THREATS WILL BE HAIL AND WIND...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AUGMENTATION ACROSS SERN PA...SRN NJ...DE...AND MD...AS WELL AS LOCALLY HIGHER DEWPOINTS INTO THE 60S F WILL OFFER A MORE FAVORABLE SETUP FOR AN ISOLATED TORNADO SHOULD CELLS MOVE INTO OR FORM IN THAT REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A HAIL AND WIND THREAT PERSISTS ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 86.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE TO PROPAGATE EWD ACROSS NRN FL ON THE LEADING EDGE OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK BUT INSTABILITY REMAINS SUFFICIENT FOR STRONG WINDS AND HAIL GIVEN AROUND 40 KT MEAN WINDS AS WELL AS COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT...RESPECTIVELY. GPS PWAT SENSORS ARE ALSO SUGGESTING AN INCREASE IN INSTABILITY WITH VALUES RISING FROM JUST UNDER 1.00 INCH TO OVER 1.30 INCHES SINCE 15Z. ..JEWELL.. 04/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS WRN NY INTO NRN PA. DAMAGING WIND AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS STABLE BILLOW CLOUDS IN THE COOLER AIR ACROSS CNTRL NY INTO NRN PA. HOWEVER...THESE HAVE BEEN ERODING FROM THE WEST AS THE AIR MASS SLOWLY DESTABILIZES. POCKETS OF HEATING HAVE ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO RISE INTO THE LOWER 70S F OVER WRN NY...WHILE COOLING ALOFT CONTINUES TO OVERSPREAD THE REGION. AREA VAD WIND PROFILES SHOW STRONG SHEAR PROFILES WITH 0-1 SRH ON THE ORDER OF 200 M2/S2 WHICH ALONG WITH LOW LCL HEIGHTS SUGGESTS A TORNADO RISK. SURFACE ANALYSIS ALSO INDICATES A MODEST PRESSURE RISE/FALL COUPLET. IF ENOUGH OF THE AREA CAN DESTABILIZE VIA MIXING AHEAD OF THE STORMS OVER FAR WRN NY/NWRN PA...THEN SEVERE WIND AND WEAK TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE AREA IS BEING ASSESSED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE TORNADO THREAT WILL CONTINUE ACROSS MOST OF TORNADO WATCH 88 THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A NEW DOWNSTREAM TORNADO WATCH MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE COLUMBIA NWS CWA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS MUCH OF TORNADO WATCH 88. RADAR TRENDS CONTINUE TO INDICATE A MIX OF SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS AND MULTICELL CLUSTERS FROM NE GA INTO UPSTATE SC. THIS LINE OF CELLS WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK NORTHEAST LATE THIS AFTERNOON. THE DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS CONTINUES TO MAINTAIN SBCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500 J/KG. CURRENT SURFACE OBSERVATIONS ALSO INDICATE THAT WINDS HAVE BECOME MORE SLY ACROSS CENTRAL SC. OF NOTE...THE CAE VWP SHOWS 0-1KM SRH OF 239 M2/S2. AS SUCH...THE TORNADO THREAT MAY SPREAD OUTSIDE THE CURRENT WATCH INTO PORTIONS OF THE COLUMBIA NWS CWA. A SMALL DOWNSTREAM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED SOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND AND HAIL THREAT TO PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS STORMS PERSIST ACROSS THE ERN HALF OF THE FL PENINSULA NEAR A LOW PRESSURE TROUGH. GIVEN THE VEERING LOW-LEVEL WINDS AND UPSTREAM CLEARING/HEATING...THESE STORMS CONTINUE TO REFORM AND ARE EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS GIVEN AVAILABLE MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY. STRONG MID TO UPPER LEVEL WINDS ARE LIKELY AIDING IN PARTICLE EVACUATION AND MAY BE MINIMIZING COLD POOLS WHICH ORDINARILY WOULD LIMIT STORM LONGEVITY. MEANWHILE TO THE W...OTHER STORMS WERE APPROACHING THE TAMPA AREA WITH RECENT INDICATIONS OF NEAR-SEVERE WINDS. HOWEVER...THE SEVERE THREAT HERE IS EXPECTED TO BE LOCALIZED. ..JEWELL.. 04/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO AFFECT THE AREA THROUGH THE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED CELLS PERSIST ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR WITHIN A LEADING SURFACE PRESSURE TROUGH CENTRAL NC INTO VA. MODIFIED 18Z SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT INSTABILITY IS CONTINUING TO INCREASE...AND VAD WINDS SHOW VEERING WITH HEIGHT WHICH IS QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS CONTAINING HAIL. WEAK CONVERGENCE HAS BEEN A LIMITING FACTOR TO STORM SEVERITY BUT WITH TIME...STORMS MAY BECOME BETTER ORGANIZED AS THE SHEAR CONTINUES TO ACT ON THEM. IN ADDITION...OTHER CELLS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP NEAR THE FRONT FROM SERN PA INTO SRN NJ WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS STRONGEST. THIS WOULD BE THE MOST LIKELY AREA FOR A TORNADO. ..JEWELL.. 04/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS PERSISTS ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WWS 86 AND 87.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE ERN EXTENT OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDS FROM THE ERN GULF TO THE W-CNTRL FL PENINSULA IS CROSSING THE TAMPA BAY AREA AT PRESENT. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD...WHERE MODEST DIURNAL SFC HEATING AMIDST SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO AROUND 70F HAS SUPPORTED MODERATE INSTABILITY. THE TBW VWP SAMPLES AROUND 40-45 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW CAPABLE OF MAINTAINING LOOSELY ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS WITH A RISK FOR LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS -- AIDED BY WATER LOADING. ELSEWHERE ACROSS REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF WWS 86 AND 87...MORE ISOLATED CONVECTION WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCALLY DMGG WIND GUSTS CONTINUE DURING THE PEAK OF THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE...THOUGH EARLIER CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING MAY RESTRICT THE OVERALL SVR-RISK TO SOME EXTENT. ..COHEN.. 04/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP NEWD ACROSS N-CNTRL PA INTO S-CNTRL NY WITH SOME SVR RISK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE CCX VWP IS SAMPLING 35-50 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW...WHICH IS ENCOURAGING THE ONGOING NEWD SPREAD OF CONVECTION FROM CNTRL PA WHILE OFFERING MODERATE DEEP SHEAR AND SOME DMGG WIND/BRIEF TORNADO POTENTIAL. THE TORNADO WATCH HAS BEEN LOCALLY EXTENDED NWD ACROSS PARTS OF N-CNTRL PA WHERE MARGINAL INSTABILITY EXISTS. AREAS FARTHER N INTO FAR N-CNTRL PA AND S-CNTRL NY WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE THROUGH THE EVENING. THIS WILL OCCUR AS MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS CONTINUE OVERSPREADING THE AREA ATTENDANT TO MIGRATORY IMPULSES ON THE ERN RIM OF A CNTRL/ERN CONUS CYCLONE AND COLD MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES CONTINUE TO OVERLIE THE REGION. HOWEVER...WITH STABLE WAVE-CLOUD STRUCTURES OBSERVED IN VIS IMAGERY AND SFC OBS SUGGESTING ONLY MODEST THETA-E...AND EVENTUAL NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION...THE OVERALL MAGNITUDE OF THE SVR POTENTIAL IS UNCERTAIN N OF THE EXPANDED OUTLINE OF WW 90. ..COHEN.. 04/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME SVR RISK PERSISTS ACROSS WW 89.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED STORMS...LOCALLY ORGANIZED IN SMALL CLUSTERS...ARE ONGOING ACROSS WW 89 AND WILL CONTINUE SPREADING ENEWD/NEWD. WIDESPREAD MID/HIGH CLOUDS HAVE STUNTED DIURNAL INCREASES IN LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...THOUGH BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTURE REMAINS ADEQUATE FOR AROUND 750-1000 J/KG OF MLCAPE. STRONG MID/HIGH-LEVEL FLOW SAMPLED BY THE RAX VWP BREEDS AMPLE DEEP SHEAR AND CONVECTIVE VENTILATION TO MAINTAIN SEMI-ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES WITH MARGINALLY SVR WIND/HAIL POSSIBLE. NOCTURNAL COOLING AND THE LACK OF STRONGER DEEP ASCENT SHOULD RESULT IN A DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/INTENSITY THROUGH THE EVENING. ..COHEN.. 04/20/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE FROM PARTS OF NORTHEAST GA INTO NORTHERN SC.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VIS IMAGERY SUGGESTS PRIMARY ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE EXTENDS FROM FAYETTE COUNTY GA...NEWD THROUGH MADISON COUNTY GA...INTO LANCASTER COUNTY SC. STRONGEST UPDRAFTS ARE PRODUCING LIGHTNING ALONG THIS BAND OF DEEPER CONVECTION BUT ARE STRUGGLING TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY...POSSIBLY DUE TO LARGE SCALE FORCING FOCUSED WELL NORTH OF THIS REGION.
